messages:
Alex R: Hey team — customer hit a 400 from /v1/rerank, says candidates arrived empty even though mobile client sends them. stack: Android app -> okhttp -> internal proxy -> redwood. Seen this once before? :thinking:
Maya (Support): Can you paste the original request body and the error we returned? Also which proxy/version?
Alex R: Error response: 400 Bad Request: "invalid_request: 'items' missing or empty". Customer provided curl/log example. Request body (from client capture):
```json
{
  "query": "how to tune batching",
  "items": [
    { "id": "a1", "text": "option A" },
    { "id": "b2", "text": "option B" }
  ],
  "top_k": 2
}
```
but server saw: 
```json
{
  "query": "how to tune batching",
  "items": [],
  "top_k": 2
}
```
Alex R: Client says they use okhttp 4.x over HTTP/2. Proxy is an in-house gateway that multiplexes frames. I grabbed gateway wirelog that shows two frames split inside the JSON array boundaries — looks like frame reorder/truncation on retransmit.
Jin (SDK): Interesting. If frames are split at a boundary and proxy reassembles incorrectly you can end up with an empty array if the bytes between brackets are dropped. Does the gateway set content-length or use HTTP/2 DATA flags correctly?
Alex R: Gateway shows this snippet: 
```
FRAME 253: HEADERS END_STREAM=0
FRAME 254: DATA len=128 END_STREAM=0
FRAME 255: DATA len=4  END_STREAM=0 payload=\",{\"id\":\"b2\"}\nFRAME 256: DATA len=0  END_STREAM=1
```
Seems like a truncated DATA frame caused middle of array to be lost during reassembly.
Maya (Support): Can you repro with curl + http2? Also ask customer to try forcing HTTP/1.1 (okhttp: .protocols(list(Protocol.HTTP_1_1))) to confirm. If 1.1 works, we escalate to eng-infra and gateway team.
Alex R: Repro steps I ran:
1) curl --http2 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank
2) Capture tcpdump at gateway and compare to server-body. Reproduced twice: server-body had empty items.
Jin (SDK): Short-term workaround: validate on client that items.length > 0 before send and fall back to HTTP/1.1 for critical paths. We'll patch okhttp sample in SDK docs showing how to force HTTP/1.1.
eng-bot: Noted incident created: INC-2026-1547 (possible gateway HTTP/2 reassembly bug).
Maya (Support): I've asked customer to test with HTTP/1.1 and to share the gateway's capture if they can. Also asked for exact gateway version and any intermediary load-balancer.
Alex R: Customer reported HTTP/1.1 worked and no 400s. They're attaching pcap, I uploaded to the incident. I'll follow up with gateway team for frame reassembly checks.
Maya (Support): Thanks. TL;DR: root cause likely proxy-level HTTP/2 DATA reassembly bug causing array contents to be dropped, producing empty candidates -> 400. Workarounds: client-side validation + force HTTP/1.1. Eng will triage gateway. :exclamation:
